gloss: detention center; internment camp; concentration camp

definitions.gloss: detention center; internment camp; concentration camp
definitions.explanation: A facility where people are confined, either for detention, internment, or imprisonment. Can refer to various types of facilities from refugee camps to wartime concentration camps.

examples.japanese: {戦時中|せんじちゅう}、{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}が{収容所|しゅうようじょ}に{送|おく}られた。
examples.english: During the war, many people were sent to internment camps.

examples.japanese: {難民|なんみん}{収容所|しゅうようじょ}の{環境|かんきょう}{改善|かいぜん}が{求|もと}められている。
examples.english: Improvements to conditions in refugee camps are being called for.

examples.japanese: {強制収容所|きょうせいしゅうようじょ}の{跡地|あとち}が{博物館|はくぶつかん}として{保存|ほぞん}されている。
examples.english: The site of the former concentration camp has been preserved as a museum.

notes:
Composed of {収容|しゅうよう} ('accommodation, detention, housing') and {所|じょ} ('place'). The word itself is neutral — the nature of the facility depends on context. It can range from a refugee processing center to a wartime concentration camp.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強制収容所|きょうせいしゅうようじょ}: concentration camp, forced internment camp
- {難民|なんみん}{収容所|しゅうようじょ}: refugee camp
- {捕虜|ほりょ}{収容所|しゅうようじょ}: prisoner-of-war camp
- {入管|にゅうかん}{収容所|しゅうようじょ}: immigration detention center
- {収容所|しゅうようじょ}に{送|おく}られる: to be sent to a camp

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {刑務所|けいむしょ}: prison — for convicted criminals serving sentences
- {拘置所|こうちしょ}: detention house — for suspects awaiting trial
- {難民|なんみん}キャンプ: refugee camp — the loanword-based alternative
